info.title: Zoho CRM Natural Language Assistant
info.description: Read-only natural-language Zoho CRM assistant. The backend receives the user's original question and dynamically resolves the CRM domain, module, fields, filters, dates, sorting, grouping, aggregation, pagination, relationships, and execution strategy using live Zoho CRM metadata. Meetings are resolved to the Zoho CRM Events API module. CRM requests must never be routed to Zoho Books and modules must never be substituted when no records are found.

post.summary: Ask Zoho CRM a natural-language read-only question
post.description: Pass the user's complete natural-language CRM question unchanged. The backend is responsible for interpreting the question, resolving the correct CRM module and live field API names, applying filters, dates, sorting, grouping, aggregation and pagination, selecting the appropriate read-only Zoho CRM API, and returning dynamic CRM records. Do not construct module names, field names, API names, filters, operators, dates, sorting, limits, offsets, or COQL in the request.

200.description: CRM request completed. The response may contain records, an aggregate result, a count, or another read-only result depending on the user's question.

apiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
apiKeyAuth.description: Backend API key. Required when BACKEND_API_KEY is configured.

question.description: The user's complete original natural-language Zoho CRM request. Pass it exactly as the user provided it. Do not rewrite, summarize, translate, interpret, normalize, or convert it into structured query parameters. Examples: 'show me deals above 50000', 'show me today's meetings', 'compare calls and meetings this week', 'show me the next 20 deals'.

conversation_id.description: Stable conversation or session identifier used only for conversational continuity such as 'proceed', 'next 20', 'next page', or other follow-up requests. Do not use this value to construct CRM queries. The backend owns all query interpretation and pagination state.

limit.description: Number of records requested for the current page.

offset.description: Number of matching records skipped before the current page.

returned.description: Number of records actually returned in the current response.

more_records.description: Whether additional matching records are available.

DynamicRecord.description: A dynamically shaped Zoho CRM record. The available columns depend on the user's question, the resolved CRM module, and live Zoho CRM field metadata.

status.description: Normalized status such as success or error.

answer.description: Natural-language answer generated from the actual CRM result. Never invent values.

records.description: Dynamic CRM records. The columns are determined at runtime from the user's question and live CRM metadata. Different questions may return different columns without changing this API schema.

count.description: Number of records returned in the current response.

module.description: Canonical CRM display module resolved by the backend.

request_type.description: Normalized read-only request type, such as records, count, aggregate, comparison, or analysis.
